main.description: An owner of the home, who runs the site, deletes for good a node that `listOrphans` lists, and what is under it: a page as `purgeDocument` takes one, a comment with the answers and the reactions to it. A group or an event does not go this way: it holds people's seats, and it still opens by its path.

purged.description: How many pages, or how many comments, went.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller does not own the home.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such node, or one that is in its place.

errors.name: NotPurgeable
errors.description: A poll or a group is under it. A vote's record and a group are nobody's to purge.
